programs.description: Kiran, a storyteller, has a loving and inseparable bond with his son, Chintan. However, their lives take an unexpected turn when Kiran becomes ill.
The sense of smell dominates the lives of three women from different walks of life. Veena is curious about her college mate Mangesh, Sarang deals with divorce and Janaki struggles with isolation.
An MLA makes his daughter carry on his political legacy but turns her into a puppet. However, she tries to make her own mark in society and stand up to her oppressive family.
